findings.text: A non-dry-run RC cut from a detached worktree that creates a commit pushes the literal `main` ref (`_run_git("push", effective_remote, "main")`), so the release commit made on the detached HEAD never reaches the remote's main and the tag points at a commit main does not contain; the cut test hides this because `_SilentPublisher` returns commit_sha=None, and the worker disclosed the gap; the plan does not settle whether such a cut should push HEAD:main or refuse.

The declared negative control says restoring *either* on-main guard makes the detached-worktree cut test fail, but the cut test calls run_release from catalog_release, so restoring only the CLI guard leaves it green; the logged mutation restored both guards at once, which demonstrates the combined regression but not the per-guard claim.

The negative-control log's header names revision 8466f0e0 (the pre-change base) although the six detached-worktree tests it runs were introduced at 9a5965792, so a reader checking the log would conclude it ran where those tests do not exist; the manifest records 9a5965792, and the log's body proves the tests ran, but the provenance line misstates the revision.
